name: Dr. Shubham Saurabh
title: Scientist C, CSIR-CRRI · Assistant Professor, AcSIR
tagline: Bridge engineering, computational mechanics, and structural design.
introduction: I work on structural health monitoring, topology optimization, mechanical metamaterials, and the application of artificial intelligence to bridge engineering.
about: I am a Scientist C in the Bridge Engineering and Structures Division at CSIR-Central Road Research Institute, New Delhi, and an Assistant Professor at the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR). My work connects bridge engineering with computational mechanics, structural health monitoring, and artificial intelligence.

I completed my Ph.D. in Structural Engineering at IIT Roorkee in 2025, following an M.Tech. at NIT Hamirpur and a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering at Dr. APJ A.K.T.U., Lucknow. My research includes robust topology optimization, auxetic metamaterials, uncertainty quantification, vibration control, and impact mechanics.
